machine.filesystem_backing: Unknown; overlay behavior and underlying physical storage are not independently verified.

limitations: Small, closed-loop in-process microbenchmark; the 250-key dataset fits in cache and is not representative of all database workloads.
Only three runs per backend, with no controlled CPU or storage isolation; results can vary substantially and are not a general ranking.
This does not measure CPU/RSS, cold starts, out-of-cache reads, deletes, recovery, network, project isolation, power-loss behavior, or reliability.
Per-write sync and SQLite WAL with synchronous=FULL are requested, but the storage guarantees and engine features are not identical or independently validated.
The prototype lacks multi-key transactions and other database features present in SQLite; low latency here is not feature parity.
